title: Metallum Subterra
description: This Mod Adds New Ores, Materials, Tools, And Later Will Also Add Armor, And Much More!
body:
Metallum Subterra Is A [JAVA] Minecraft Mod That Adds New Materials Like:

- Ingots,

- Ores,

- Raw Ores,

But Also:

- Tools,

- Armor, (COMING SOON!)

- And much, much more!  (COMING SOON!)

NOTE FROM DEVELOPER: This Project Is A Side-Project, And (Probably) Won't Get Much Updates After It's Beta Release. So If You Will Find This Mod Fun, And Would Want More Updates, Please Share This Mod To Others You Know!
